scope: Research first; no production code changes in this research turn

sources.finding: Programmatic execution and structured computer actions are both supported; preserve execution state and return fresh observations. This is not disclosure of all production internals.
Bind permitted actions to the original target at execution; prior observation does not freeze page state.

sources.kind: official cookbook example, not comparative experiment
sources.finding: Separate working context, reusable memory, and reviewable factual artifacts; compact at meaningful boundaries.
DOM and AXTree share unique element identifiers (bid), with screenshot/geometry metadata and ID-based actions. Exact stability across all DOM mutations is not established by this review.

200 live-web tasks; evaluate requirement coverage and efficiency. Appendix A.9 reports benefits from 100 to 200 steps for Opus 4.6, but not comparable gains for Qwen 3.5-9B. Does not establish the effect of raising Rune budgets.
sources.caution: Appendix states 44.5% and 86/200 for the same baseline; these are arithmetically inconsistent. Do not treat the exact effect size as independently replicated.

sources.finding: Reuse abstract workflows induced from evaluated past trajectories. Evidence from Mind2Web/WebArena and older models is not a guarantee for current NOL pages.

Deterministic evaluation of typed response data and captured network traces. Paper landing page required browser verification, so this review relies on the authors repository for implementation details.
108 long-horizon workflows expose constraint tracking and verification failures; benchmark task complexity differs from NOL comparison.

confirmed_local_findings.finding: Duplicate role/name elements receive listed refs but no bound handle; action then rejects them. Re-observation does not remove ambiguity.

Classification says browser/edit; incomplete browser result formatter replaces partial answer with generic saved-result failure. A comparison should verify retrieved offers, not imply a requested save.

Cumulative usage across 35 calls was 1442725 tokens, including 1012027 cache-read, 1426232 input and 16493 output. Not one 1.44M-token context. 57275 tokens remained in final accounting; runtime entered budget answer-reserve/incomplete state.
Rune already has session, journal recovery and browser history compaction. Additional state/compaction proposal must improve these rather than assume they are absent.

DOM findings and partial quotes exist; distinct exact fee/coupon/cancellation completeness was not established. Snapshot quotation checks alone cannot prove semantic association or final payable total.

hypotheses_requiring_measurement: How much token use comes from schemas/prompts, ordinary extraction outputs, repeated snapshots and retries separately.
Whether fresh targeted vision or node identity fixes improve NOL task completion under equal budgets.
How much increasing budget helps after deterministic reference and completion-contract defects are fixed.
recommended_experiments: Reproduce duplicate buttons and DOM replacement locally; newly observed duplicates must resolve to specific nodes, retired refs must never click replacements.
Separate information retrieval, reversible UI state and external business effects; verify comparison and booking with different outcome contracts.
Persist per-property/date/occupancy/room/rate evidence with timestamps and missing fields; preserve verified partial results through interruption.

Compare baseline, node binding, targeted screenshot fallback, persisted evidence and short programmatic batches under the same model/request/budget. Run repeated trials, then held-out domestic/overseas sites.
Record full completion, per-field verified coverage, false success, wrong target actions, latency, cached/uncached tokens, cost and resume duplication separately.

research_harness.role: corroboration only; root manually checked citations and did not adopt unverified date or cross-mutation stability claims

non_claims: No evidence OpenAI solves NOL perfectly.
No measured effect size for proposed Rune changes.
